Container.Name: DebridDownloader
Container.Overview:
A downloader for Real-Debrid, TorBox, Premiumize and AllDebrid that runs on your server and is managed from a browser. Add a magnet or a .torrent file, pick the files you want, and they download to your array over several connections at once.
Downloads resume after a dropped connection, a container restart or a crash, and expired debrid links refresh by themselves. You can pause, resume and retry one download or all of them, and set a speed limit and a limit on how many run at once.
This is the headless container: the same download engine as the DebridDownloader desktop app, with its interface served in your browser on port 8777.
FIRST START: set an Access token below. The web UI asks for it when you open it. Then sign in to your debrid provider in the web UI; the provider token is saved in the Config folder.
The web UI speaks plain HTTP. Beyond your home network, put it behind a reverse proxy with TLS or a VPN such as Tailscale.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings, download state and secrets.json (your provider token and the access token). Small; keep it on appdata.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Where finished and in-progress downloads are written.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The DebridDownloader interface in your browser, and its HTTP API.

Config.Name: Access token
Config.Description: The token the web UI and API ask for. Pick a long random one.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the downloads are written as (99 is nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the downloads are written as (100 is users).
